notes.title: Check out Epic Auto Towers, a game from our son, a professional game developer!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

Our journey into gamdev started after our son, a professional game developer, inspired us, his parents, to get into game development too!

Today he announced his new game: Epic Auto Towers! It's a turn-based strategy game with deckbuilding and autobatler elements. The game is going to be super awesome, so add it to your Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116060/Epic_Auto_Towers/

notes.title: Card Storm Idle 1.0 - the Full Release
notes.content:
After a long period of development, we are happy to announce that the Card Storm Idle game is coming out of early access into full release

The recent major update has added decks, relics, skills, Heroes and achievements to the game. 
We hope this addition will appeal to both new players and those already familiar with the game.

notes.title: Relics bugs fixed. Slight visual adjustments.
notes.content: Relics bugs fixed. Slight visual adjustments.

notes.title: Fixed some technical bugs
notes.content: Fixed some technical bugs

notes.title: New decks, relics, skills, achievements and locations have been added.
notes.content:
New decks, relics, skills, achievements and locations have been added.

Unlock the red Heroes deck and try different skills of each hero!
Unlock the Shadow deck, and the game will go to a new level of idle.
Enter the Dungeons and increase the power of your weapons with precious metals!
Try to get new achievements!

notes.title: Button Hard Reset
notes.content:
Added button 'Hard Reset' to the settings.
The game will start from scratch!

notes.title: 1000 Items.
notes.content:
Added the ability to buy items in a stack.
 
When the CTRL key is held down and the SHIFT key is held down, 
you can buy up to 1000 items.

notes.title: Vortex Prestige.
notes.content:
Added option to Super Prestige - Vortex Prestige. 
If you take Vortex Prestige, the normal Prestige will not reset.

notes.title: Acceleration
notes.content: The Acceleration card now works more correctly and is more powerful.

notes.title: "Servant of Kamazots"
notes.content:
Fixed problems with multiple bats flying out at level 2. 
Now, if a pack of more than 10 bats is gathered, 
one slightly larger bat will fly out with a load of all coins.

notes.title: Added instructions to the game
notes.content:
To make it easier for newcomers to understand the game, 
we have compiled a small manual. 
Better late than never!

notes.title: The actions of keys CTRL and SHIFT are extended to prestige and relics.
notes.content:
The actions of keys CTRL and SHIFT are extended to prestige and relics.
When the CTRL key is held down, you can buy up to 10 pcs,
when the SHIFT key is held down, you can buy up to 50 pcs.

notes.title: Effects adjustments
notes.content: Added to the settings an option for adjusting effects.

notes.title: CTRL/10, SHIFT/50
notes.content:
Added the ability to mass card purchases. 
When the CTRL key is held down, you can buy up to 10 cards,
when the SHIFT key is held down, you can buy up to 50 cards.

notes.title: The numbers are formatted
notes.content:
We tried to find all the big numbers and formatted them. 
We hope none of them are hidden!

notes.title: Magic Chest card bug fix
notes.content: Magic Chest. The magical power of this card was out of control,  but we brought it back within described limits!

notes.title: Technical amendments
notes.content: Fixed a glitch with a GOLDEN IDOL relic

notes.title: Some update of the game text
notes.content: Made some text corrections.

notes.title: Game updated
notes.content:
The problem with too many stars is solved.
 Now there are fewer stars, but their value is higher.

notes.title: Game updated
notes.content: To our great regret, the final build of the game had a few fatal errors. We apologize to the players, and try to fix bugs as quickly as possible. In this build fixed bugs in the relics.
